FBI denies director's Russia trip, confirms Virginia presence

The FBI has denied reports that its director, Kash Patel, traveled to Russia. The agency confirmed that Patel was in Virginia at the time the reports surfaced. The reports, which circulated amid accusations against Ukraine for allegedly helping Putin, were corrected by MS NOW, which had initially stated Patel had landed in Russia.
